origin.description: Assistant synthesis of the user-directed recovered vision; implementation and economic advantage require separate evidence.
Historical proposal supporting this meaning; not automatic authority.

payload.statement: Use Projector knowledge to guide a real change and a subsequent change in a fresh session, detect deliberately stale knowledge, and compare the combined setup, retrieval, repair, and maintenance cost with a capable ordinary agent using search, code, tests, and concise notes. Passing self-authored tests does not prove economic advantage. Retire historical planning material only after useful intent and rationale are recoverable through the working system.
payload.title: Demonstrate cumulative value on Projector itself
